svg.text: Three capture gardens on two flanks and a high bridge; pressure one, rotate to another.
20 m | grid 10 m | top view 1 m = 7.47 px
DISTANCE & TIME / estimates, not playtest results
77 ÷ 6.5 m/s + 3–6 s obstacle / queue allowance. Ground route passes UNDER the flat centre (+3 m); 2.3 m
underside clearance. Leave one garden to contest another.
102 ÷ 6.5 m/s + 2–4 s obstacle / queue allowance. Two 14 m approaches; defenders must give up a garden to stack
Jump envelope: g = 20 m/s²; vᵧ = 7.5 m/s → apex 1.41 m; flight 0.75 s; 6.00 m at 8 m/s. No mandatory gap jump; use the
drawn continuous lanes. Avoid jumping under overhead hazards. Height sections and map rules govern falls.
60 spots are drawn at true bean diameter 0.8 m. Collider sizes and movement sweeps are in metres. All controls,
timings, friction, grouping and respawn rules are proposed Level-panel data.
Own side, 3 s respawn delay; no capture allowed from spawn pad.
2 teams, 30 slots each. Four 12 m paths around the central bridge.
8 m sweep, wide bypass; knocks but does not eliminate.
